item.title: Urgent lane closure Melton Road West Bridgford for seven days
item.description: National Grid are excavating in the area to locate a low voltage fault. The works are on Melton Road for 100 m from 80 to 86 at the North Road junction travelling towards the city. Temporary traffic signals will operate from 9 am until 5 pm until Monday 19 January.

item.title: £1.3m refurbishment at historic Beeston Station progressing
item.description: Work is progressing on a £1.36 million project to completely refurbish the waiting shelters and a historical canopy at Beeston station. Network Rail’s investment will address significant deterioration across the platform 1 and 2 structures to improve safety for passengers while preserving the grade II-listed station’s heritage.
